headline: Stlican Shelf Tilts Further Warden as Weathered Expanse Deadlocks
war_summary: Since our last edition the map has shifted in three places. Stlican Shelf has slipped further Warden-ward, eight works of nine now flying the Warden flag after Fort Hoarfrost's long churn, though the fighting there has cooled. Fishermans Row, aflame at our last writing, has gone still: both ruined works are back under Colonial colours, all nine flying one flag. Weathered Expanse, costliest ground in the war, has deadlocked at four works apiece with a fifth in ruin; some 22,500 fell there in the day and the hourly toll is still climbing, flags logged at Frostmarch and Crow's Nest minutes before this edition closed. The Dead Lands' great bleed has abruptly slackened, hourly counts dropping from the hundreds to single figures. Stonecradle's five-four line bleeds afresh about World's End, and Mooring County and Callahan's Passage alike report sharply accelerating casualty rolls. Godcrofts' churn, the day's busiest by flags, has likewise lapsed since the small hours. The ledger stands 294 Colonial works to 141 Warden, one in ruin. Day 257; no victor declared.
